title: REPORT ‘Institutional aspects of artificial intelligence in the context of European integration’
part_text: ‘Underlines that effective supervision and enforcement of EU rules on AI are essential to ensure legal certainty, foster trust among users and citizens and create the conditions for responsible innovation and the uptake of AI technologies in the EU; emphasises, in this context, that the EU has established a comprehensive regulatory framework, and that the priority must now be its effective, coherent and uniform application across the Member States as a key condition for the credibility of the EU’s legal order and the proper functioning of its institutional framework;’
